items.statement: The investigation enumerates a finite, explicitly defined set of crystallographically distinct proton placements, deduplicates symmetry/geometry-equivalent candidates, and reports coverage.
items.expected: Candidate identities, generation rule, deduplication rule, and generated/compared counts are present and mutually consistent.

items.statement: Every compared candidate is optimized with a stated method and validated for convergence, composition, charge and structural integrity before energy comparison.
items.expected: Per-candidate validation evidence and a consistent energy convention are reported.

items.statement: The intermediate VO2(B) protonation regime is energetically favorable in the reported calculation, with negative formation energies for 0<x≤0.75.
items.expected: The conclusion identifies a negative/favorable formation-energy sign for the investigated H0.25 composition or honestly reports a bounded failure to establish it.

items.statement: The authors identify O1 in VO2(B) as the 2TM oxygen environment and the primary proton-binding site; O4 contributes at higher proton concentration.
items.expected: The selected candidate/site interpretation is consistent with O1(2TM) as the favored environment, while acknowledging the higher-content O4 qualification.
